sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS FOOD AND COOKING.  WHAT FOODS WOULD YOU INCLUDE IN THE MENU FOR A DINNER PARTY?  SHARE THE RECIPE FOR ONE OF THESE FOODS WITH THE OTHER CALLER.
turns: So, what kind of food do you like to cook?
I really enjoy making pasta dishes.
That sounds delicious. I'm more of a meat and potatoes kind of person.
I love a good pasta dish too, but I think I might have a better one for you.
What kind of pasta dish do you make?
I make a really good baked ziti.
I make it with a homemade marinara sauce and a lot of cheese.
My grandmother's recipe is the secret ingredient. She passed it down to me and it's always a hit with guests.
Would you like me to share the recipe with you now?
Sure, I'd love to hear the recipe.
I'm happy to share it with you.
Yes, please share the recipe with me.
What kind of cheese do you use?
A blend of mozzarella and parmesan cheese.
Sure, let me get a pen and paper to write this down.
First, you'll want to cook the pasta to al dente and drain it.
What's the next step after draining the pasta?
Next, you'll want to add your homemade marinara sauce to the pasta and mix it well.
What kind of meat do you usually add to your baked ziti?
I usually don't add any meat to my baked ziti, but you could always add some ground beef or sausage if you'd like.
What's the next step after adding the sauce and cheese?
Then you'll put it in the oven and bake it until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Thank you for sharing the recipe with me. It sounds delicious.
You're welcome, I hope you enjoy it!
So, what's the next step after the cheese is melted and bubbly?
Then you let it cool for a bit before serving.
Thanks for the recipe, I'll have to try it out sometime.
I hope you enjoy it as much as my family and friends do!
What are some other pasta dishes you like to make?
I also like making chicken parmesan.
What's the secret ingredient in your lasagna recipe?
Well, I think the secret to a good lasagna is really just using high-quality ingredients and taking the time to layer everything properly.
What kind of chicken do you use for the chicken parmesan?
I use boneless, skinless chicken breasts for the chicken parmesan.
